    <p class="eyebrow">About</p>
    <h1 id="about-title">Igor B. Martins</h1>
    <p class="opening">I am an economic historian and researcher in the Department of Economic History at Lund University.</p>
    <p>I hold an MSc and PhD in Economic History from Lund University and have previously worked as a postdoctoral researcher at Lund and the University of Cambridge.</p>
    <p>My current work contributes to research projects on the political economy of the Cape Colony and the historical development of inequality in Africa. I also examine labour and labour-market integration in Ghana, resilience to economic contraction in developing countries, and the relationship between climate exposure, asset ownership, and inequality.</p>
    <p>Alongside this research, I study changing patterns of international scientific cooperation and their implications for research policy and geopolitics. My consultancy work includes projects for STINT and the United Nations Development Programme.</p>
